[[bin]]
name = "cbindgen"
path = "src/main.rs"
doc = false
required-features = [ "clap",]

[[bin]]
name = "gbindgen"
path = "src/gmain.rs"
doc = false
required-features = [ "clap", "gobject",]

[package]
name = "cbindgen"
version = "0.28.0"
authors = [ "Emilio Cobos Álvarez <emilio@crisal.io>", "Jeff Muizelaar <jmuizelaar@mozilla.com>", "Kartikaya Gupta <kats@mozilla.com>", "Ryan Hunt <rhunt@eqrion.net>",]
license = "MPL-2.0"
description = "A tool for generating C bindings to Rust code."
keywords = [ "bindings", "ffi", "code-generation",]
categories = [ "external-ffi-bindings", "development-tools::ffi",]
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/cbindgen"
edition = "2018"
rust-version = "1.74"
exclude = [ "tests/profile.rs",]
default-run = "cbindgen"

[dependencies]
indexmap = "2.1.0"
log = "0.4"
serde_json = "1.0"
tempfile = "3"
toml = "0.8.8"
proc-macro2 = "1.0.60"
quote = "1"
heck = "0.4"

[dev-dependencies]
pretty_assertions = "1.4.0"

[features]
default = [ "clap",]
unstable_ir = []
gobject = []

[lib]
name = "cbindgen"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[workspace]
exclude = [ "tests/depfile/single_crate_config", "tests/depfile/single_crate_default_config", "tests/depfile/single_crate", "tests/rust/bitfield", "tests/rust/dep_v2", "tests/rust/dep_v2/dep", "tests/rust/derive_eq", "tests/rust/expand_default_features", "tests/rust/expand_dep_v2", "tests/rust/expand_dep_v2/dep_v2", "tests/rust/expand_dep_v2/dep", "tests/rust/expand_dep", "tests/rust/expand_dep/dep", "tests/rust/expand_features", "tests/rust/expand_no_default_features", "tests/rust/expand", "tests/rust/external_workspace_child", "tests/rust/literal_target", "tests/rust/mod_2015", "tests/rust/mod_2018", "tests/rust/mod_attr", "tests/rust/mod_path", "tests/rust/package_version", "tests/rust/rename_crate", "tests/rust/rename_crate/dependency", "tests/rust/rename_crate/no_extern", "tests/rust/rename_crate/old_dep", "tests/rust/workspace", "tests/rust/workspace/dep",]

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.103"
default-features = false
features = [ "derive",]

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0.85"
default-features = false
features = [ "clone-impls", "extra-traits", "fold", "full", "parsing", "printing",]

[dev-dependencies.serial_test]
version = "2.0.0"
default-features = false

[package]
authors = [ "Maxwell Koo <mjkoo90@gmail.com>",]
build = "build/main.rs"
description = "Rust bindings for libepoxy, an OpenGL function pointer manager."
keywords = [ "epoxy", "libepoxy", "opengl", "gl", "gtk",]
license = "Apache-2.0"
name = "epoxy"
repository = "https://github.com/mjkoo/epoxy-rs"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2015"
publish = false

[build-dependencies]
gl_generator = "0.14"
pkg-config = "0.3"

[dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[features]
default = [ "gl_generator/unstable_generator_utils",]
debug_marker = []

[[example]]
name = "win32-test"
required-features = [ "qmp",]

[package]
name = "qemu-display"
version = "0.2.1"
authors = [ "Marc-André Lureau <marcandre.lureau@redhat.com>",]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77"
description = "Helper library to communicate with qemu -display dbus"
repository = "https://gitlab.com/marcandre.lureau/qemu-display"
keywords = [ "D-Bus", "DBus", "QEMU", "Virtualization", "VM",]
license = "MIT"
categories = [ "virtualization", "gui", "api-bindings",]

[features]
qmp = [ "dep:qapi", "dep:base64",]

[dependencies]
tracing = "0.1"
cfg-if = "1.0"
libc = "0.2"
serde_repr = "0.1"
serde_bytes = "0.11"
once_cell = "1.19"
futures = "0.3"
async-broadcast = "0.7"
async-trait = "0.1"
async-lock = "3.4"
memmap2 = "0.9.5"

[dev-dependencies]
pixman-sys = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = "0.3"
rand = "0.10"

[dependencies.zbus]
version = "5.0"
features = [ "p2p", "serde_bytes",]

[dependencies.derive_more]
version = "2.1"
features = [ "debug",]

[dependencies.enumflags2]
version = "0.7"
features = [ "serde",]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = [ "derive",]

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
features = [ "async-await-macro",]

[dependencies.qapi]
version = "0.15"
features = [ "qmp",]
optional = true

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies.async-std]
version = "1.12"
features = [ "attributes",]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
uds_windows = "1.1"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.62"
features = [ "Win32_Networking_WinSock", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_IO", "Win32_System_Memory", "Win32_System_Threading",]

[target."cfg(windows)".dev-dependencies.async-std]
version = "1.12"
features = [ "attributes",]

[target."cfg(windows)".dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3"
features = [ "env-filter", "fmt",]
default-features = false

[package]
name = "rdw4"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Marc-André Lureau <marcandre.lureau@redhat.com>",]
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = [ "wayland", "x11",]
bindings = [ "dep:system-deps",]
wayland = [ "dep:wayland-protocols", "dep:gdk-wl", "dep:glib-unix",]
x11 = [ "dep:gdk-x11", "dep:x11",]
capi = [ "dep:env_logger", "dep:cargo_metadata", "dep:cbindgen",]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
derivative = "2.2.0"
libc = "0.2.186"
libloading = "0.9"
gl = "0.14.0"
usbredirhost = "0.4"
futures-channel = "0.3"
futures-util = "0.3"

[build-dependencies.cargo_metadata]
optional = true
version = "0.23"

[build-dependencies.cbindgen]
path = "../cbindgen"
features = [ "gobject",]
optional = true

[build-dependencies.system-deps]
version = "7.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.khronos-egl]
version = "6.0"
features = [ "dynamic",]

[dependencies.keycodemap]
package = "rdw-keycodemap"
path = "../keycodemap"
version = "0.1"

[dependencies.env_logger]
version = "0.11"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.glib-unix]
version = "0.22"
optional = true

[dependencies.wayland-protocols]
version = "0.32"
features = [ "unstable", "client",]
optional = true

[dependencies.x11]
version = "2.21"
optional = true

[dependencies.epoxy]
git = "https://github.com/theCapypara/epoxy-rs.git"
rev = "7d9d88a8dfec2ddedc647b7a8f6c1e5b3e6c6ec0"

[dependencies.gtk]
features = [ "unsafe-assume-initialized", "v4_16",]
package = "gtk4"
version = "0.11"

[dependencies.gst]
package = "gstreamer"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-app]
package = "gstreamer-app"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-audio]
package = "gstreamer-audio"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gdk-wl]
package = "gdk4-wayland"
features = [ "v4_4", "egl", "wayland_crate",]
optional = true
version = "0.11"

[dependencies.gdk-x11]
package = "gdk4-x11"
features = [ "v4_4", "egl",]
optional = true
version = "0.11"

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies]

[package.metadata.system-deps.rdw4]
version = "0.1"
feature = "bindings"

[package.metadata.capi.header]
name = "rdw"
subdirectory = "rdw4"
generation = false

[package.metadata.capi.pkg_config]
filename = "rdw4"
requires = "gtk4"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.62.2"
features = [ "Win32_Devices_HumanInterfaceDevice", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_Graphics_Dxgi", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_WindowsProgramming", "Win32_UI_Input", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_Graphics_Direct3D11",]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.gdk-win32]
package = "gdk4-win32"
features = [ "v4_4", "win32", "egl",]
version = "0.11"

[package]
name = "rdw4-qemu"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Marc-André Lureau <marcandre.lureau@redhat.com>",]
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = []
bindings = [ "rdw/bindings",]
capi = []

[build-dependencies]
cargo_metadata = "0.23"
system-deps = "7.0"

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
futures-util = "0.3"
futures = "0.3"
async-trait = "0.1"
pixman-sys = "0.1.0"

[build-dependencies.cbindgen]
path = "../cbindgen"
features = [ "gobject",]

[dependencies.zbus]
version = "5.0"
features = [ "p2p", "serde_bytes",]

[dependencies.rdw]
package = "rdw4"
path = "../rdw4"
default-features = false

[dependencies.qemu-display]
git = "https://gitlab.com/marcandre.lureau/qemu-display.git"
rev = "8ac3da95abeca92e5bb0aee2c58adf54e86f4482"

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
uds_windows = "1.1.0"

[package.metadata.system-deps.rdw4-qemu]

feature = "bindings"

[package.metadata.capi.library]
name = "rdw4-qemu"

[package.metadata.capi.header]
name = "rdw-qemu"
subdirectory = "rdw4"
generation = false

[package.metadata.capi.pkg_config]
filename = "rdw4-qemu"
requires = "rdw4"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.62"
features = [ "Win32_System_Memory", "Win32_Foundation",]

[package]
name = "rdw4-rdp"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = [ "Marc-André Lureau <marcandre.lureau@redhat.com>",]
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = []
bindings = [ "rdw/bindings", "dep:system-deps",]

[dependencies]

derivative = "2.2.0"
futures-executor = "0.3"
futures-util = "0.3"
futures-channel = "0.3"
tracing = "0.1"
whoami = "2.1"

[build-dependencies.cargo_metadata]
optional = true
version = "0.23"

[build-dependencies.cbindgen]
path = "../cbindgen"
features = [ "gobject",]
optional = true

[build-dependencies.system-deps]
version = "7.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.ironrdp]
version = "0.15.0"
features = [ "cliprdr", "dvc", "displaycontrol", "session", "connector", "rdpdr", "graphics", "pdu", "rdpsnd",]

[dependencies.ironrdp-tokio]
version = "0.9"
features = [ "reqwest",]

[dependencies.ironrdp-tls]
version = "0.2.1"

[dependencies.x509-cert]
version = "0.2"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.52.3"

[dependencies.rdw]

[dependencies.nix]

[package.metadata.capi.library]

[package.metadata.capi.header]
name = "rdw-rdp"
subdirectory = "rdw4"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]

[features]

[build-dependencies.cargo_metadata]

[package]
name = "spice-gtk-usb-portal"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "Bridge between spice-gtk and the USB portal"
authors = [ "Marco Köpcke <hello@capypara.de>",]
edition = "2024"

[lib]
crate-type = [ "cdylib", "rlib", "staticlib",]

[features]
default = [ "parent_window_gtk4", "spice",]
spice = [ "dep:spice-client-glib",]
